presentation.label: GENERATIVE
presentation.summary: Generate, evolve and scale-lock a phrase on any audio track, played by the stock sequencer.
presentation.overview: SEQGEN writes real trigs, PTCH/HOLD/VOL locks, slides and optional chance conditions, micro-timing and retrigs into the selected audio track of the current pattern. The stock sequencer plays them, so transport, tempo, track speed, length, scale and swing stay the instrument’s own. Nine original generator styles, seven evolve styles, eighteen scales and phrase transforms are inspired by the five12 Vector sequencer. Development draft: emulator and hardware results are pending.
highlights: Nine generators and seven evolve styles
Eighteen scales with root, re-fit and in-scale transpose
Optional evolve every 1–16 track loops, following the track’s own loop
Real, editable trigs and locks on any audio machine
usage: Pending: the exact access gesture is confirmed against the MKI key map before release.

controls.name: ALGO
controls.doc: Generator style: ACID, BARL, CELL, OBLQ, RAND, EUCL, TEKN, MIRR, DRUM. Original algorithms modelled on Vector generator behaviour; not note-identical.

controls.name: DENS
controls.doc: 0–16. Share of steps that get notes; 0 is silence. EUCL uses it as the pulse count, TEKN as the size of the pitch set.

controls.name: SPAN
controls.doc: 0–12 semitones either side of neutral PTCH; pitches stay in the scale.

controls.name: GATE
controls.doc: Base AMP HOLD for generated notes, in stock HOLD units. 127 is INF and ties consecutive notes with slides.

controls.name: ACNT
controls.doc: Difference between accented and other notes, written as AMP VOL locks relative to the Part’s AMP VOL.

controls.name: SEED
controls.doc: Deterministic variation. YES advances it; other edits keep it.

controls.name: EVO
controls.doc: Mutation style: LOW, MED, HIGH, SWIZ (shuffle pitch, gate and volume), SW-P, SW-G, SW-V (shuffle one lane).

controls.name: AMNT
controls.doc: 0–100 %. Share of steps an evolve touches.

controls.name: AUTO
controls.doc: OFF, or evolve every 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 loops of the track, counted from the track’s own step counter.

controls.name: PROB
controls.doc: 0–100 %. Share of generated notes that get a stock X% trig condition (50–87 %). 0 writes no conditions.

controls.name: RTCH
controls.doc: 0–100 %. Share of generated notes that get RTRG/RTIM retrig locks (2–4). Flex and Static only. 0 writes none.

controls.name: GRV
controls.doc: 0–23. Largest random micro-timing offset in stock units. 0 writes none.

controls.name: ROOT
controls.doc: C–B. Root of the scale; the sample is assumed to sound C at neutral PTCH.

controls.name: SCAL
controls.doc: Eighteen scales from Vector’s built-in list; every generated and evolved note stays in it.

controls.name: FIT
controls.doc: ON also re-fits the track’s existing PTCH locks when SCAL or ROOT changes.

controls.name: TRNS
controls.doc: −12 to +12 scale steps; stored midpoint 12 means none.

limitations: Development draft: native glue, emulator, MKI hardware and persistence are not tested yet.
Generated pitch is limited to the native ±12-semitone PTCH range on audio tracks. MIDI tracks are planned for a later version.
Free-run lanes, Vector’s free clock rates and live sub-sequencers are not implemented: they would need a second clock. A lock-based sub-sequencer page is planned as a later add-on.
Direction modes are left to the Play Modes module.
Trig-condition, micro-timing and RTRG/RTIM encodings are unverified until the emulator check; PROB, GRV and RTCH default to 0, which writes none of them.
